framings.text: I think this is about giving the next person a clear, low-effort record of which checks used a real model or a stub, while letting people reject unhelpful questions permanently.

outcome: The next person can quickly tell what was actually checked before trying Tinkery, without extra work for every small edit, and unhelpful questions stay out of future checks.

questions.text: Who decides what the record must show: you, the PR author, or the next person reviewing it? The Ledger: link shows every decision and whether it is settled.

alternatives.label: A short record attached to each PR
alternatives.benefit: The next person can see check results in the place where they review the change.
alternatives.cost: Someone or something must keep the record current.
alternatives.undo_cost: Removing old records may make past checks harder to audit.

alternatives.label: A shared check history with a brief PR summary
alternatives.benefit: Small edits need less repeated recording, while the PR can still point to prior checks.
alternatives.cost: The next person must open another place to see full details.
alternatives.undo_cost: Moving back to PR-only records may lose the wider history.
